status: Unfitted experimental directional hypothesis; no optimized thresholds
inputs: Existing fixed-four first-receipt gross OI quantities; 1m and 5m windows
quantity: 100 * (PE_net - CE_net) / total gross additions and removals
aligned: 5m CE_net<0 and PE_net>0 gives UP if 1m quantity>0. Converse gives DOWN if 1m quantity<0.
mixed_reversal: A continuous mixed episode remembers its immediately preceding aligned state. Bull-origin mixed gives DOWN only when 1m quantity<0 and 5m quantity has decreased since the preceding receipt. Bear-origin mixed gives UP only when 1m quantity>0 and 5m quantity has increased.
neutral: Other complete inputs produce NEUTRAL; not a forecast of flat price
reset: Missing 1m/5m inputs or receipt gap above 90 seconds clears state memory; no-flow clears mixed origin. No future receipt or outcome used.
window: 09:50 to before 15:00 IST; current status unavailable after 90s stale or at 15:00
evaluation: All 4633 previously studied observations over 15 sessions, forward 5m/10m and preceding 5m, normal/expiry, first five/later ten sessions, all eligible rows and greedily spaced >=600s directional rows per session. Baselines raw5 strict, quantity5 sign, 1m/5m quantity agreement. All results retained; no winning rule chosen.
limitation: Exploratory, previously examined sessions; not untouched holdout, no trading P&L or calibrated probabilities. September 17 screenshot is not used to fit or score the rule.
